project_info.theme: Emotional reality of adapting to life in France
project_info.color_palette: Warm Sunset Orange, Deep Brown, Streetlight Amber, White

main_subject.detail: A moody Paris street scene at dusk with the Eiffel Tower centered in the distance, café tables and diners in the foreground, warm shop signs and lanterns glowing on the right, and a reflective Vietnamese quote overlaid in elegant white type.
main_subject.style: Cinematic lifestyle street photography with emotional travel-editorial text overlay.

composition_elements.text:
Những ngày đầu ở Pháp,
điều khiến mình áp lực nhất
không phải là giao tiếp...
mà là học cách tự mình xoay sở
với cuộc sống hoàn toàn mới.
items: Top Left: Warm Paris street canyon leading toward the Eiffel Tower silhouette.
Top Right: Café storefront, glowing lamps, and signage including 'BLANC DES VOSGES'.
Bottom Left: Large decorative opening quotation mark and the first lines of the white italic quote.
Bottom Right: Outdoor café seating, menu board, and the last lines of the quote.
Center/Background: Sunset sky behind the Eiffel Tower, parked cars, pedestrians, and narrow street perspective.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Warm dusk sky, practical lamp glow, reflective pavement, intimate travel mood, and strong editorial quote legibility.
